## Description

Submit authorised prescriptions to the emirate's eRx service; issue electronic sick-leave certificates in the accepted format; letters and certificates (referral, fitness, medical report) from templates, signed and sent to the portal.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** eRx submissions return a regulator reference stored on the prescription; failures are visible and retryable.
- [ ] **AC2.** Sick-leave certificates follow the regulator format and are signed by an authenticated doctor action.
- [ ] **AC3.** Letter templates produce signed PDFs released to the portal.

## Definition of Done

All acceptance criteria above, **plus** the cross-cutting X1–X8 checklist in [docs/05-delivery](../../docs/05-delivery/README.md#definition-of-done-every-ticket).
